question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

To _______ the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.
solution:
The correct answer is '**confirm**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**confirm**" means to establish the truth or correctness of something. (पुष्टि करना)
 
• In the context of the sentence, Amit had to visit the travel agency many times to verify or establish the validity of the ticket.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *To confirm__ the ticket, Amith had to visit the travel agency many times.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Contract (अनुबंध)**: means a written or spoken agreement, especially one concerning employment, sales, or tenancy, that is intended to be enforceable by law.
 
• **Conform (अनुरूप होना)**: means to comply with rules, standards, or laws.
 
• **Convention (सम्मेलन)**: means a large meeting or conference, especially of members of a political party or a particular profession.
